[SWS_DM_01474] DM shall allow access only to unlocked
SOVD
entities
Upstream requirements:
RS_Diag_04264
⌈
DM shall not allow a SOVD client to access a SOVD entity which requires a lock, but
the client has not acquired the lock before, and will send HTTP status code 409 as a
response.
⌋
